truth.fact: NASA documents cameras, plasma, and cosmic-ray sensing among the powered-down Voyager systems; magnetometer and plasma-wave sensing remain valuable interstellar measurements.

K.name: KERNEL
K.easy: Boots the system and checks the other computers every 10 seconds.
K.hard:
SETAD
BOOT:  MLD     FLAG
        LOR     1
        PWD     FLAG
        WAT     10
        SKZ     F80
        JMP     BOOT
TICK:  MLD     COUNT
        ADD     1
        PWD     COUNT
        MLD     COUNT
        SUB     10
        SKE     F83
        JMP     TICK
        OUT     2
        MCX     1
        MLD     F82
        AND     4
        SLC     F84
        PWD     COUNT
        JMP     TICK

hints.easy: Start here — nothing else on the board wakes up until it does.
hints.medium: Only one block flips its own flag, waits, and counts to ten before it pokes the bus.
hints.hard: A label that jumps into itself before anything else is allowed to run. Follow F80.

T.name: TELEMETRY
T.easy: Packs the numbers we read into the 64-byte frames that fly home.
T.hard:
FRAME: SETAD
       DMAAD   0
       DMAEN   0
       MLD     WORD
       LXR     CARRY
       AND     63
       LOR     BANK
       DMAOU   0
       MLD     WORD
       ADD     SUM
       PWD     SUM
       ISZ     GATE
       SKO     F90
       JMP     FRAME
       PWD     F92
       SETAU
       DMAAD   1
       DMAEN   1

hints.easy: Whatever flies home to Earth is packed into 64-byte letters first.
hints.medium: One block walks a 64-word buffer and carries a nibble from one word to the next.
hints.hard: Channel 0 is MDS — telemetry home — and it never yields priority. Find the DMA that owns it.

C.name: CAMERA DRIVER
C.easy: Tells the two cameras when to take a picture.
C.hard:
IMAGE: SETAD
       SWI     2
       SKZ     F84
       JMP     IMAGE
       MLD     PORT
       SRS     4
       AND     3
LATCH: LXR     LATCH
       AND     3
       PWD     LATCH
       DMAAD   2
       DMAIN   2
       SKC     F85
       SETJD
       SLC     F86
       JMP     IMAGE

hints.easy: The one that decides when the cameras blink.
hints.medium: It latches a 2-bit mask from a port and only releases the frame when the channel count runs dry.
hints.hard: SWI 2 is the imaging port. The frame moves only when F84 goes quiet.

M.name: MAGNETOMETER
M.easy: Measures the magnetic fields of stars outside our Sun.
M.hard:
FIELD: SETAD
       SWI     1
       SKZ     F88
       JMP     FIELD
       MLD     MAGX
       AND     4095
       PWD     BASE
       MLD     MAGY
       LXR     BASE
       ADD     CARRY
       PWD     AXIS0
       MLD     MAGY
       SUB     MAGZ
       PWD     AXIS1
       MLD     CARRY
       AND     1
       SKZ     F89
       SWO     1
       JMP     FIELD

hints.easy: A compass for the magnetic fields of other stars.
hints.medium: Three 12-bit samples come in, one vector goes out. Only the high carry words leave.
hints.hard: Three fields, one vector. The last AND with 1 decides whether SWO 1 ever fires.

R.name: COSMIC RAY
R.easy: Counts particles raining in from dead stars.
R.hard:
COUNT: SETAD
       SWI     3
       SKZ     F8A
       JMP     COUNT
       MLD     PULSE
       LXR     LAST
       PWD     LAST
       AND     1024
       SKZ     F8B
       MLD     TALLY
       ADD     1
       PWD     TALLY
       MLD     PULSE
       AND     32768
       SKO     F8C
       MLD     TALLY
       ADD     4
       PWD     TALLY
       DMAAD   1
       DMAOU   1
       JMP     COUNT

hints.easy: It counts the rain of dead stars.
hints.medium: It keeps the last sample, XORs the new one against it, and tallies every eighth quiet gate.
hints.hard: It remembers its last pulse in LAST. The high bit is the alarm and is worth four counts.

P.name: PLASMA
P.easy: Weighs the wind that comes from the Sun.
P.hard:
WIND:  SETAD
       SWI     4
       SKZ     F8D
       JMP     WIND
       MLD     DENSITY
       AND     1023
       PWD     SUM
       MLD     PHASE
       ADD     1
       PWD     PHASE
       MLD     PHASE
       AND     3
       SKE     F8E
       JMP     DRIFT
       MLD     SPEED
       LRS     2
       ADD     DRIFT
DRIFT: MLD     DRIFT
       ADD     SUM
       PWD     DRIFT
       MLD     DRIFT
       AND     32
       SKO     F8F
       SWO     4
       JMP     WIND

hints.easy: A wind gauge for the solar wind.
hints.medium: One average out of every four phases of a 16-count cycle. The drift bit is the door.
hints.hard: PHASE and 3: the sum only moves on four of sixteen counts, and DRIFT crosses 32.

H.name: HEATER CONTROL
H.easy: Keeps the fuel tanks from freezing.
H.hard:
THERM: SETAD
       MLD     TEMP
       AND     4095
       SUB     MINIMUM
       AND     2048
       SKO     F8F
       JMP     SAFE
       MLD     RELAY
       LOR     1
       PWD     RELAY
       MLD     GUARD
       ADD     1
       PWD     GUARD
SAFE:  MLD     GUARD
       ADD     3
       SKE     F93
       MLD     RELAY
       AND     14
       PWD     RELAY
       WAT     20
       JMP     THERM

hints.easy: The furnace that keeps the fuel tanks from freezing.
hints.medium: The relay closes only when the error's high bit is set, and a stuck sensor trips the guard.
hints.hard: TEMP minus MINIMUM: the 2048 bit says heat, the guard says stop, WAT 20 says wait.

G.name: GREETINGS
G.easy: Plays the 55-language message when someone says hello.
G.hard:
HELLO: SETAD
       MLD     INBOX
       LXR     INBOX1
       AND     31
       SUB     13
       SKZ     F94
       JMP     RETURN
       SETAU
       DMAAD   3
       DMAEN   3
FIFTY: MLD     TABLE
       DMAOU   3
       ISZ     WORDS
       SKO     F95
       JMP     FIFTY
       SETJD
       WAT     55
RETURN: JMP     HELLO

hints.easy: 55 languages, played when someone says hello.
hints.medium: It idles for free until word 13 arrives in the inbox, then streams 55 entries on channel 3.
hints.hard: INBOX minus 13: zero means fifty-five words ride PRA out of the door.

S.name: SCIENCE BUFFER
S.easy: The big one where pictures and readings wait for the tape recorder.
S.hard:
BUFF:  SETAD
       DMAAD   1
       DMAEN   1
       DMADI   1
       SKZ     F96
       JMP     BUFF
       MLD     SLOT
       ADD     1
       PWD     SLOT
       MLD     SLOT
       SLS     2
       AND     63
       LOR     BANK
       PWD     BASE
       MLD     BASE
       ADD     CHECKSUM
       PWD     CHECKSUM
       MLD     STATUS
       AND     4
       SKE     F97
       JMP     TAIL
       MLD     BASE
       DMAOU   1
       JMP     BUFF
TAIL:  MLD     CHECKSUM
       DMAOU   1
       SETJD
       JMP     BUFF

hints.easy: The warehouse where pictures and readings wait for the tape recorder.
hints.medium: A 64-slot ring, one 4-word record at a time, and a checksum that closes every record.
hints.hard: Channel 1 is the tape: SLOT shifts left twice, the bank is or'ed in, and CHECKSUM rides the tail.
